`enum Axis`<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.utils.align` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [Axis.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/utils/align/Axis.java)

The horizontal or the vertical direction.

## Description

It sets the direction of a flex layout and of a scroll event.

## Learn more

- [Flex layout](/use/learn/describing-the-ui/flex-layout/)
